Game Overview

Chubsee puts players into a animal experience centered on guide Chubsee, the charming, adventurous bird, on his journey around the world. With simple tap controls, help him navigate obstacles and reach new heights. Each swift tap elevates Chubsee through vibrant, eye-catching landscapes, offering endless high-score fun. Soar with Chubsee and explore the globe!
